topic: Using a map scale ratio to find real-world distance
core_question: On a map, the scale is 1 inch equals 25 miles. If two cities are 6 inches apart on the map, how far apart are they in real life, in miles?
answer_summary: the cities are 150 miles apart (6 inches times 25 miles per inch)
